steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Line: defines edges, creates movement, suggests direction. Colour: communicates emotion, creates emphasis, establishes mood. Tone: creates form, depth and atmosphere through light and dark. | Key Fact: Shape (2D) and form (3D): geometric shapes feel man-made; organic shapes feel natural. Texture: actual (real surface) vs visual (implied through mark-making). | Key Fact: Pattern: the repetition of a motif — can be regular (predictable) or irregular (organic, varied). | Key Fact: Formal elements are the BUILDING BLOCKS of visual language — understanding them gives you the vocabulary to analyse and create effectively.
